Mr. Banerjee, Additional Non-Executive Director effective July 24, 2014, will vacate office at the said AGM. (2) Appointment of Mr. R. E. Lerwill, for a period of five years from the date of the ensuing AGM, as a Non-Executive Director. Mr. Lerwill, Additional Non-Executive Director effective November 18, 2013, will vacate office at the said AGM. (3) Appointment of Mr. S. B. Mainak, for a period of five years from the date of the ensuing AGM, as a Non-Executive Director. Mr. Mainak, Additional Non-Executive Director effective April 25, 2014, will vacate office at the said AGM.
